title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #7

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does Paramatma mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. The Supreme Soul
   C. A holy river
   D. A daily prayer

2. How should we say the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   C. While eating
   D. While running

3. Why is integrity compared to a strong wall? (1 mark)
   A. One weak brick can make it fall
   B. Because it is tall
   C. Because walls are white
   D. Because it is heavy

4. Which activity shows how to care for the environment? (1 mark)
   A. Burning waste in the field
   B. Cutting trees for fun
   C. Planting a tree in the school compound
   D. Throwing rubbish out of a matatu

5. In which script is Guru Granth Sahib Ji written? (1 mark)
   A. Gurmukhi
   B. Roman
   C. Arabic
   D. Swahili script

6. What rescue is Parshvanath known for in a well-known story? (1 mark)
   A. A drowning child
   B. A snake in a burning log
   C. A lost cow
   D. A wounded swan

7. What does the Twameva prayer teach us about God? (1 mark)
   A. God is a stranger
   B. God is far and angry
   C. God cares for us like a parent and friend
   D. God is only a king

8. Which is a benefit of yoga? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us noisy
   B. It gives instant riches
   C. It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   D. It stops rain

9. Which is a good way to save water? (1 mark)
   A. Leave taps running
   B. Pour water on the road
   C. Close the tap fully after use
   D. Wash the car every day

10. How would you practise Ahimsa at school? (1 mark)
   A. By hurting insects
   B. By not bullying and by caring for animals
   C. By teasing the smaller children
   D. By breaking things

11. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   B. Kalpasutra: Hinduism
   C. Dhammapada: Sikhism
   D. Ramayan: Buddhism

12. What does the Vedic saying say about the truth? (1 mark)
   A. It is unknown
   B. It has many separate truths
   C. It is one but is called by many names
   D. It is only for kings

13. What does the word Enlightened mean in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Full of the light of true knowledge
   B. Very loud
   C. Very rich
   D. Very tall

14. What should you do with your shoes before entering a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Throw them
   B. Carry them inside
   C. Remove them
   D. Wear them

15. Match the being to the teaching. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Ram Das: Cruelty
   B. Narsimha: Greed
   C. Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   D. Buddha: Pride

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three activities to learn about temples. (3 marks)

17. Describe how the boy in the example story practised Asteya. (3 marks)

18. Name the two Buddhist scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

19. Name the months of the Indian traditional calendar in which Maha Shivratri and Paryushan fall. (3 marks)

20. Name the four Purusharthas. (2 marks)

21. Explain the Jain teaching called Asteya. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — The Supreme Soul
   It is the highest soul, God.

2. B — Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   Calm and clear.

3. A — One weak brick can make it fall
   Small lies can weaken trust.

4. C — Planting a tree in the school compound
   Planting trees helps the environment.

5. A — Gurmukhi
   It is written in Gurmukhi.

6. B — A snake in a burning log
   He asked the man to stop and the snake was saved.

7. C — God cares for us like a parent and friend
   God is called our mother, father and friend.

8. C — It helps us breathe well and stay calm
   Yoga calms the body and mind.

9. C — Close the tap fully after use
   Closing taps stops waste.

10. B — By not bullying and by caring for animals
   Ahimsa means not harming others.

11. A — Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   The Uttaradhyayan Sutra is a Jain scripture.

12. C — It is one but is called by many names
   The truth is one, the wise call it by many names.

13. A — Full of the light of true knowledge
   Enlightened beings are wise and full of true knowledge.

14. C — Remove them
   Shoes are removed to keep it clean and show respect.

15. C — Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   Parshvanath is linked with non-violence.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make a collage of temple pictures, map Mandirs on a sketch map or digital map, draw and colour a Mandir, visit one with permission (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: He found a purse with money, did not keep it, and asked around until he found the owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Dhammapada and the Sigalovada Sutta.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Maha Shivratri in Phalguna and Paryushan in Bhadrapada.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each and 1 mark for correct spelling.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Not taking what is not given, or not stealing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.
